# GammaRips

> One options trade a day. Scored overnight. Pushed to your phone at 9:50 ET, right before the 10:00 entry.

GammaRips is a paper-trading options engine for working professionals. Every weeknight it scans 5,230+ US equities for institutional overnight options flow, applies deterministic quality gates, and publishes at most one trade idea at ~9:50 ET, right before the 10:00 ET entry. The trade has a pre-set stop (−30% on the option), pre-set target (+40%), and a same-day exit (flat at 15:45 ET on the entry day — no overnight hold). Free users see the pick on the webapp; Pro subscribers get it pushed to WhatsApp and can @mention an AI agent in the private group.

Paper-trading, educational only. Not investment advice.

## Gate stack (V7.1)

1. **Scanner** — overnight signals across 5,230 tickers.
2. **Enrichment** — `overnight_score >= 4 AND directional_uoa_usd > 500000, BULLISH-only, delta edge-ranked to top ~50`.
3. **Signal-notifier** — Two safety rails: no earnings on the trade day; VIX <= VIX3M. Then a randomized 3-bracket consensus tournament over the ~50 bullish setups picks 1 (or none). Just before the pick is published, a live open-interest re-check drops any contract too illiquid to actually trade, so the pick is one a subscriber can realistically enter and exit at fair prices.
4. **Forward paper-trader** — enters 10:00 ET, −30% stop, +40% target, exits flat at 15:45 ET the same day. Stop wins over target on ambiguous bars.

## MCP server (free, no auth)

- Endpoint: `https://gammarips-mcp-406581297632.us-central1.run.app/sse`
- Transport: SSE
- Primary tool: `get_todays_pick`
- All 18 tools: `get_todays_pick`, `list_todays_picks`, `get_freemium_preview`, `get_overnight_signals`, `get_enriched_signals`, `get_signal_detail`, `get_enriched_signal_schema`, `get_signal_performance`, `get_win_rate_summary`, `get_open_position`, `get_position_history`, `get_daily_report`, `get_report_list`, `get_available_dates`, `web_search`, `get_market_calendar_status`, `get_signal_explainer`, `get_historical_performance`.

## Pricing

- **Free** — today's pick on the webapp at 09:50 ET, full signals list, daily report, public scorecard, all 18 MCP tools.
- **Pro $39/mo** — everything in Free, plus a WhatsApp push at 09:50 ET, an exit reminder at 15:45 ET (same-day close), and an AI chat agent inside the private WhatsApp group. 7-day free trial. Cancel anytime.

Paper-trading performance, educational only. Not investment advice. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results. Options trading involves substantial risk of loss. GammaRips does not make personalized recommendations and does not manage customer funds.
